title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 The States of Kerala (561) and Tamil Nadu (437) registered higher female convict inmates in their prison in 1996. In percentage terms Mizoram (22%), Meghalaya (16%), Manipur (12%), Tamil Nadu (9.8%) and Karnataka (7.7%) recorded higher percentage of female convicts as compared to the total convicts held in Prisons.
